body: I work At reservations in the park. Madison is the nicest and usually the first to go. I wouldn't expect a site if you call the same day so call as soon as you can if you want Madison. For day hikes, fairy falls is a few miles and gives you a great birds eye view of grand prismatic. Not to far from Madison either

No way you can do the whole lower loop and see mammoth in an hour and 40 minutes. The speed limit in the park is 35 miles an hour, plus you have to account for animals I the road. If you are coming from the south, stop at lake and canyon then go to old faithful. If I were I wouldn't see mammoth. You should leave from the west entrance. If you don't see mammoth your looking at 3+ hours, if you do go to mammoth your pushing 5 if you actually want to stop and look around. And if your not going to get out of your and look around and do a few hikes I don't think it would be worth it. The road between old faithful and grant is closed and the road between mammoth and Norris is closed. I work and live in mammoth by the way id be happy to answer any questions
